functionalRequirement: User shall be able to set the price, quantity, upload pictures, and add details when listing an item.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must validate that 100% of item listings contain all required fields (price, quantity, at least one picture, and item description) before submission is allowed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to provide multiple pieces of information when listing an item, necessitating validation to ensure completeness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must process image uploads of up to 10MB per image with a maximum of 10 images per listing within 3 seconds on a standard broadband connection (10 Mbps).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR includes uploading pictures, which requires efficient handling of potentially large files to maintain a smooth user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The item listing creation process must complete within 5 seconds from submission to confirmation, including all data validation and storage operations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The listing process involves multiple operations (storing price, quantity, images, details) that need to be performed efficiently to maintain user engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The item listing interface must provide clear visual indicators for all required fields and show real-time validation feedback within 500ms of user input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves multiple data entry points that users need to complete correctly, requiring intuitive guidance and feedback.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The image upload component must support drag-and-drop functionality and preview capabilities for all uploaded images before final submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR includes uploading pictures, which should be made as intuitive and error-proof as possible for users of varying technical abilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must preserve user-entered data in case of connection interruption or system failure, allowing users to resume the listing process without data loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The listing process involves multiple steps and data entry, which should be protected against potential interruptions or failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All uploaded images must be scanned for malware and verified as valid image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or HEIF) before being stored in the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user-uploaded content which presents a security risk if not properly validated and sanitized.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The item listing module must be implemented as a separate component with well-defined interfaces to allow for independent updates to pricing models, image handling, or detail requirements.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR combines multiple distinct functionalities that may evolve independently, requiring a modular approach for maintainability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the addition of new item attributes and listing options without requiring changes to the core listing functionality or database schema.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions adding details, which suggests a need for flexibility in what information can be captured about items.

functionalRequirement: Doctors shall be able to log in to check patient information, answer patient queries, perform daily activities, set reminders, and communicate with their staff.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide access to 100% of relevant patient information (medical history, test results, prescriptions, and notes) required for clinical decision-making.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires doctors to check patient information, which must be complete and appropriate for their needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must load patient records within 2 seconds and support simultaneous access by at least 50 doctors during peak hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Doctors need quick access to patient information to perform their daily activities efficiently, especially in time-sensitive situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must process and deliver patient queries to doctors within 1 minute of submission and support at least 500 concurrent patient-doctor message threads.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR includes answering patient queries, which requires timely delivery and processing of messages.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide a unified dashboard that displays all pending patient queries, upcoming reminders, and staff communications with priority indicators and allows access to any function within 3 clicks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves multiple activities that doctors need to perform, requiring an intuitive interface that minimizes cognitive load.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain 99.9% uptime during hospital operating hours (24/7 for emergency departments, 8am-8pm for other departments) with scheduled maintenance windows communicated at least 72 hours in advance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Doctors rely on the system for critical daily activities and patient care, requiring high availability and predictable maintenance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement multi-factor authentication for doctor logins and automatically log out inactive sessions after 15 minutes to protect patient data confidentiality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves access to sensitive patient information, requiring strong authentication and session management.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All patient data access must be logged with doctor identification, timestamp, and accessed records, with logs retained for at least 7 years to comply with healthcare audit requirements.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves checking patient information, which requires accountability and auditability for regulatory compliance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the addition of new communication templates, reminder types, and daily activity workflows without requiring system downtime or code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR encompasses multiple functionalities that may need to evolve with changing medical practices and hospital policies.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must be compatible with at least 3 major Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and support standard healthcare data exchange formats (HL7 FHIR, DICOM) for patient information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Doctors need to access patient information that may be stored in various systems, requiring interoperability with existing healthcare infrastructure.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must clearly highlight critical patient information (allergies, drug interactions, recent test results) with visual indicators and confirmation dialogs before allowing prescription or treatment decisions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves checking patient information for clinical decision-making, where overlooking critical data could lead to patient harm.
